_comment: zaakafhandelapp's capability matrix, the only authored copy. Rows come from two directions: 'category' rows (origin: category) are dossiq's 225 rated rows reused by id, because both products compete for the same buyer against the same systems, and their four competitor cells are dossiq's driven readings, cited per cell in evidence and never re-read here; 'own-code' rows (origin: own-code) come from reading zaakafhandelapp's own code, and every competitor cell on them is unknown because nobody has read a competitor against them yet. Our own column is a code reading of development at cdac51b0f9 on 2026-09-26, with the page or route that reaches each capability in reachedOn. Rows whose only basis is an x-openregister declaration sit in pending. Standing caveat for every yes: the app ships no register (tests/e2e/ci-seed.sh:23), so a fresh install reaches none of these pages until someone provisions register zaakafhandelapp by hand; row z.0 carries that fact.
category: Dutch municipal case handling (zaakgericht werken, VNG GEMMA and ZGW). zaakafhandelapp is the case worker's workbench on Nextcloud and OpenRegister: zaken with zaaktypen, statussen, rollen, besluiten and resultaten, tasks, customers and contact moments, a personal work queue, and a ZGW-shaped REST surface (ZRC, ZTC, DRC, BRC) that other systems can call. A buyer compares it against a zaakafhandelcomponent such as Dimpact ZAC or Valtimo/GZAC, against an integrated zaaksysteem such as xxllnc Zaken or OpenCase, and, for the API half, against the ZGW registration Open Zaak. It is the same category as dossiq (the intelligence database even records zaakafhandelapp as merged into procest, dossiq's old name, on 2026-07-23), which is why this matrix reuses dossiq's rows and driven competitor readings rather than researching the field again.
